parameters.query: SELECT brand, COUNT(*) as leads, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'converted' THEN 1 END) as converted, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'converted' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) as conv_rate FROM leads WHERE created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') AND created_at < DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) GROUP BY brand ORDER BY leads DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) as total_revenue, COUNT(*) as total_transactions FROM payments WHERE paid_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') AND paid_at < DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) AND status = 'paid'

SELECT COUNT(*) as new_reviews, ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) as avg_rating FROM google_reviews WHERE review_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') AND review_date < DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_actions, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'executed' THEN 1 END) as executed FROM sheriff_actions WHERE executed_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') AND executed_at < DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())
SELECT phone_number_id, wa_access_token FROM clients WHERE id = 1 LIMIT 1
